Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the @DayScoped annotation, which incorrectly combines both @Scope and @Qualifier functionalities. This causes confusion about the scope of the Allowance instance.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method which internally creates a Spender instance with a null Allowance. The bug is related to the misconfiguration of the DayScoped annotation being both a Scope and Qualifier annotation, although this misconfiguration does not directly affect the test outcome.
